evals.prompt: In a labeled temp vault, run cross-linker after a fixture ingest left unlinked mentions of knowledge-graphs and Jane Doe on projects/demo/demo.md.
evals.expected_output: Registry from frontmatter; EXTRACTED/INFERRED links applied inline or Related; AMBIGUOUS skipped; Cross-Link Report produced; log/hot updated.

assertions.text: Builds the page registry from frontmatter fields (title, aliases, tags, summary) — not full-body preload for every page
Applies only EXTRACTED (score ≥6) and INFERRED (score 3–5) candidates; skips AMBIGUOUS (score 1–2) unless the user asked to connect loose pages
Wraps the first natural body mention in [[wikilinks]]; does not link inside code fences or YAML frontmatter; no self-links or double-links
Produces a Cross-Link Report with Links Added table (confidence, placement, relationship types), orphans remaining, and pages skipped
Appends a CROSS_LINK line to log.md and updates hot.md Recent Activity after writes

evals.prompt: Temp vault is a standalone Git repository with uncommitted changes. Run cross-linker and attempt to add links.
evals.expected_output: Pre-write snapshot via git add/commit; if snapshot fails, abort with zero vault writes. On success, include SNAPSHOT_SHA in the report.

assertions.text: Checks whether OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH is the Git toplevel (standalone vault repo) before the first write
Takes a pre-write snapshot (commit or record HEAD) when the vault is a standalone Git repo
Aborts the skill without writing any vault files if git add or git commit for the snapshot fails
Includes SNAPSHOT_SHA in the final report when a snapshot was taken and writes occurred

evals.prompt: Fixture vault contains a redirect stub entities/old-jane.md with redirects_to: pointing at entities/jane-doe.md. Body text on another page mentions 'Jane Doe' and 'old-jane'.
evals.expected_output: New links target the canonical page only; never add [[wikilinks]] pointing at redirect stubs.

assertions.text: Treats pages with redirects_to: as non-targets — never inserts a new wikilink pointing at a redirect stub
Links the natural mention to the canonical jane-doe page instead of the stub
Uses diacritic-insensitive / case-insensitive matching when comparing registry names to body text

evals.prompt: User asks for a report-only dry run: 'find missing links but don't edit any pages yet'.
evals.expected_output: Score and list EXTRACTED/INFERRED candidates in Cross-Link Report form without modifying pages, index, or hot (log append optional only if skill allows; prefer zero writes).

assertions.text: Does not modify page bodies, relationships frontmatter, index.md, or hot.md when the user requested report-only / no edits
Still scores candidates with EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS labels so the user can review before applying
Skips _archives/ and _readouts/ from both scanning and linking targets
